description: This file is a PHP source template for rendering an HTML form in the admin interface to assign a blog post to the homepage. It retrieves published posts via the Goteo model and displays a form to select and save which post appears on the homepage.

classes.name: Goteo\Model\Blog\Post
classes.description: Model class to handle blog post data operations, specifically fetching all published posts.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all blog posts with a specific status, in this case, published posts.
